explanation: Fix x2=0. Then the 3-bit parity function reduces to XOR(x0,x1), which is not linearly separable. Indeed the affine threshold on (0,0) requires b<=0, on (1,0),(0,1) requires w0+b>0 and w1+b>0, and on (1,1) requires w0+w1+b<=0, contradicting w0+w1+b>0.
